I’ve been having shortness of breath or difficulty breathing, and my heart feels like it’s beating fast or irregular with palpitations—especially with physical exertion, and it gets worse when lying down but improves when I sit up. I also have sensitive, knife-stroke pain in my lower chest and right breast, about 8/10.

How old are you, and what sex were you assigned at birth?

Yes—I’m having shortness of breath and my lower chest/right breast pain right now.
Does the chest pain get worse with a deep breath, coughing, or movement/pressing on the area?

Yes—my symptoms are worse when lying down, and they improve when I sit up.
